DISASSEMBLY SERVICE POINTS
<<A>> TRANSFER DRIVEN GEAR REMOVAL
1. Support the transfer driven gear with general service tool or 
special tool MD998917(F4A42), and then set them on the 
press.
2. Push down on the output shaft with the press to remove the 
transfer driven gear.
<<B>> TAPER ROLLER BEARING REMOVAL
1. Support the taper roller bearing with the special tool 
MD998801, and then set them on the press.
2. Push down on the output shaft with the press to remove the 
tapper roller bearing.
ASSEMBLY SERVICE POINTS
>>A<< TAPER ROLLER BEARING INSTALLATION
1. Set the output shaft on the press support stand.
2. Using special tools MD998823 <F4A42>, MD998827 
<F4A51>, MD998812 and MD998814, press install the taper 
roller bearing.
>>B<< OUTER RACE INSTALLATION
Use the special tools MB990936 <F4A42>, MB990937 
<F4A51> and MB990938 to tap the outer race in the bearing 
retainer.
